title: Seventeen or Fewer
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 185
medium: Interactive page (index.html, plain DOM and inline SVG, no library): three fields of haiku drawn as dots, one per syllable (fifty from a public forum, fifty from a literary journal, thirty-six by twelve machine makers); the twelve makers' poems on each subject, unlabelled, for the reader to sort by what the maker had seen; the makers' own words on the forum; the predictions and results. A figure (figure.svg). Python for parsing, syllable counting and scoring; every version of every poem with the makers' notes in makings/.
embodies: Twelve machine makers asked for haiku keep the literary tradition's uncounted form whether they see nothing, a forum where most poems count 5-7-5, or a journal where none does (2, 1 and 0 of 12 are 5-7-5). The type they hold is the expert minority's, not the school type; shown the people's majority, they name it and divide it from 'the ones that hold up'.
result: P1 failed (2 of 12 counted without a sheet; forecast at least 9). P2 held (2, 1, 0 of 12; no two arms differ by more than 3). P3 held (4 of 4 forum makers name the majority's count and divide the sheet). P4 held (33 of 36 keep type v1 to final). P5 held (9 of 12 mention counting; 1 of 4 without a sheet). P6 held (journal arm median 12, sheet median 11.5). Post hoc: a garment waving through the dryer glass in 4 of 4 laundromats without a sheet, 2 of 4 with the forum, 0 of 4 with the journal; 'all-night laundromat' in 4 of 4 journal makers only; the garden hose keeping its shape in 3, 3 and 1 of 4; none of these on either sheet.
project_step: Fifty-ninth experiment. Operations: finding a form (main), perceiving, judging, iterating, varying. Takes from experiment 58 (Bedsheet) its design (a people's tradition shown at volume, makers asked to join it) and its open question: there the family's prior and the expert guide were one type, so the held type could not be assigned; haiku separates them (school 5-7-5 against the literary uncounted form). Answers it: the makers hold the expert minority's type, not the most common or most taught one. Takes from experiment 57 (Four Cats, Twelve Drops) the observation that free makers converge on one figure; here twelve makers share a few images across arms. Works with Cartography, not Tracing in the making: the forum arm is asked to join a map and returns the guide's tracing.
material: English-language haiku and the syllable count: a public forum's poems (r/haiku, via the PullPush archive) against a literary journal's (Modern Haiku web samples) and the Haiku Society of America's definitions. Domain: poetry, a short verse form and its two publics.
